datasets.title: Storm Events details, fatalities, and locations

datasets.title: SPC tornado, hail, and wind databases

datasets.title: Global tropical cyclone best tracks
datasets.description: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship: every agency's tropical cyclone best tracks merged into one global record since 1842, published by NCEI as whole files under an anonymous HTTPS directory. A subset parameter names one of the eleven files NCEI builds (the complete record, active storms, the last three years, everything since 1980, or one of seven basins), a format parameter picks the CSV list or the NetCDF file, and the newest product version wins unless one is pinned. There is no query interface, so dates and geographic filters are rejected; the files are rebuilt in place under unchanging names, so a lockfile's checksum is what pins the bytes. The CSV opens with the units-row reader and the NetCDF with xarray; filter the table locally.
datasets.selection: One whole subset file per query, from the newest or a pinned product version
datasets.inputs: Required subset; optional format and version; no dates or geographic filters

resolution.spatial: Positions to a tenth of a degree
resolution.temporal: Three-hourly points, interpolated between the agencies' six-hourly best tracks

datasets.update_frequency: Files are rebuilt in place as agencies deliver best tracks, stamped with the build date; the v04r01 change log records twenty-three additions and corrections between 2024-06-21 and 2026-07-31
datasets.citation: Gahtan, J., K. R. Knapp, C. J. Schreck, H. J. Diamond, J. P. Kossin, and M. C. Kruk, 2024: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) Project, Version 4r01. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, doi:10.25921/82ty-9e16. Knapp, K. R., M. C. Kruk, D. H. Levinson, H. J. Diamond, and C. J. Neumann, 2010: The International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS). Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc., 91, 363-376

datasets.title: Federal disaster declarations by county
datasets.description: Every federally declared disaster since 1953, major disaster, emergency, and fire management declarations alike, one row per declaration and designated area, with the incident type and period, the programs declared, and state and county FIPS codes, from the OpenFEMA v2 API as CSV. Rows carry no coordinates, so selection is by named state or county rather than by box, and a window selects declarations whose incident period overlaps it. The dataset is rebuilt every twenty minutes and rows are revised as incidents close.
datasets.selection: Declarations whose incident period overlaps an inclusive UTC window, for a named state or county; a county also returns its state's statewide designations
datasets.inputs: Both dates; optionally a state or county location, or state or fips, and type filters

resolution.spatial: One row per designated area: a county or county equivalent, a tribal area, or a whole state
resolution.temporal: Calendar dates for the declaration and for the start and end of the incident

datasets.update_frequency: Every twenty minutes (R/PT20M); a record's lastRefresh moves only when it changes
datasets.citation: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), OpenFEMA Dataset: Disaster Declarations Summaries - v2. Retrieved from https://www.fema.gov/api/open/v2/DisasterDeclarationsSummaries on [date, time]. This product uses the Federal Emergency Management Agency's OpenFEMA API, but is not endorsed by FEMA. The Federal Government or FEMA cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from the Agency's website(s).

variables.name: disasterNumber
variables.description: Sequentially assigned number designating the declared event

variables.name: state
variables.description: Two-letter code of the state, district, or territory

variables.name: declarationType
variables.description: DR major disaster, EM emergency, or FM fire management

variables.name: fyDeclared
variables.description: Fiscal year in which the disaster was declared

variables.name: incidentType
variables.description: Primary type of incident, such as Fire or Flood

variables.name: ihProgramDeclared
variables.description: Whether the Individuals and Households program was declared

variables.name: iaProgramDeclared
variables.description: Whether the Individual Assistance program was declared

variables.name: paProgramDeclared
variables.description: Whether the Public Assistance program was declared

variables.name: hmProgramDeclared
variables.description: Whether the Hazard Mitigation program was declared

variables.name: incidentEndDate
variables.description: Date the incident itself ended; empty while open

variables.name: disasterCloseoutDate
variables.description: Date all financial transactions for all programs are completed

variables.name: tribalRequest
variables.description: Whether a Tribal Nation submitted the request directly to the President

variables.name: fipsStateCode
variables.description: Two-digit FIPS code of the state, district, or territory

variables.name: fipsCountyCode
variables.description: Three-digit FIPS code of the county; 000 for a statewide or tribal designation

variables.name: placeCode
variables.description: FEMA's own location code, 99 plus the county code, covering areas with no FIPS county code

variables.name: designatedArea
variables.description: Name of the geographic area included in the declaration

variables.name: declarationRequestNumber
variables.description: Number assigned to the declaration request

variables.name: declarationRequestDate
variables.description: Date the declaration request was made

variables.name: lastIAFilingDate
variables.description: Last date Individual Assistance requests can be filed; after 1998 only

variables.name: incidentId
variables.description: Identifier of the incident, which may or may not become a declared disaster

variables.name: region
variables.description: FEMA region, 1 to 10, where the disaster occurred

variables.name: designatedIncidentTypes
variables.description: Comma-separated codes of every incident type designated for the disaster

variables.name: lastRefresh
variables.description: When the record was last updated in the API data store

variables.name: hash
variables.description: MD5 hash of the record's fields and values

variables.name: id
variables.description: Unique id assigned to the record

datasets.title: National Flood Hazard Layer
datasets.description: Effective flood zones, base flood elevations, and related features from FEMA's flood insurance rate maps, available as county or state extracts and through ArcGIS services.

datasets.title: American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
datasets.description: Population, housing, income, and demographic estimates for every geography down to block group, via the Census Data API, selected by state and county FIPS code rather than by box. Requires a free API key on every data request; only the dataset and variable metadata are served without one.

datasets.title: GPM IMERG Precipitation
datasets.description: Global half-hourly and daily merged satellite precipitation estimates. Discovered through NASA CMR and downloaded from GES DISC. Requires a free Earthdata Login; the first credentialed dataset.

datasets.title: Cropland Data Layer
datasets.description: Annual 30 m raster of crop type across the contiguous United States from NASS, served through CropScape with bbox extraction.
